fields.name: Fey Wanderer
fields.desc: A ranger subclass that wanders the boundary between worlds, carrying Feywild magic on their shoulders. Dreadful Strikes (3rd): deal 1d4 psychic damage once per turn on a hit with a weapon (doesn't stack with Hunter's Mark). Fey Wanderer Magic: charm person, misty step, dispel magic, dimension door, mislead. Otherworldly Glamour (3rd): add Wisdom modifier to Charisma checks; proficiency in Deception, Performance, or Persuasion. Beguiling Twist (7th): when a creature within 120 feet succeeds on a save against being charmed or frightened, you can use reaction to redirect the effect to a different creature within 30 feet of the original target (Wisdom save or be charmed/frightened for 1 minute). Fey Reinforcements (11th): learn summon fey for free; cast it once per long rest without a slot. Misty Wanderer (15th): cast misty step without a slot (proficiency bonus uses/long rest); can bring a willing creature along when you do.

script.hook: Fey Wanderer's Dreadful Strikes adds 1d4 psychic damage once per turn, not per attack.
script.body: Dreadful Strikes at 3rd level adds 1d4 psychic damage on a weapon hit once per turn, which doesn't stack with Hunter's Mark. Players mistakenly apply it to every attack, but it's a single bonus per turn. Consistent damage comes from leveraging this on every turn, not from hoping for high rolls.
script.cta: DMs: Remind players Dreadful Strikes is once per turn; enforce it to maintain balance and focus their strategy.
